components.name: Plain text parser
components.tradeoffs: Fast and deterministic; preserves little layout.

components.name: PDF parser
components.description: Page-aware PDF extraction with OCR signalling.
components.tradeoffs: Good for digital PDFs; scanned pages need isolated OCR workers.

components.name: Fixed overlap chunker
components.tradeoffs: Cheap and measurable; may split semantic sections.

components.name: Sentence-aware chunking
components.description: Packs complete sentences into bounded chunks.
components.tradeoffs: More readable evidence; sentence splitting varies for abbreviations and tables.

components.name: Recursive paragraph chunking
components.description: Preserves paragraphs before applying word windows.
components.tradeoffs: Retains document structure; very long paragraphs still require hard splits.

components.name: Deterministic hash embeddings
components.tradeoffs: No API cost but not semantically meaningful; never use as a quality baseline.

components.name: OpenAI embeddings
components.tradeoffs: Strong semantic retrieval; adds network latency and usage cost.

components.name: PostgreSQL with pgvector
components.tradeoffs: One operational system for vectors and metadata; tune indexes at scale.

components.name: Vector retrieval
components.tradeoffs: Simple and low latency; exact terms can be weaker than keyword search.

components.name: Hybrid retrieval
components.tradeoffs: Higher recall across semantic and exact queries; more tuning and latency.

components.name: Reciprocal Rank Fusion
components.tradeoffs: Robust across unlike score scales; adds fusion parameters.

components.name: Redis/ARQ ingestion
components.tradeoffs: Resilient large-file processing; adds Redis and worker operations.

components.name: Hit@K
components.description: Whether any relevant chunk appears in the first K results.
components.tradeoffs: Simple success signal; does not reward multiple relevant results.

components.name: Precision@K
components.description: Relevant results as a share of the first K results.
components.tradeoffs: Measures result cleanliness; can penalize useful but unlabelled evidence.

components.name: Recall@K
components.description: Share of known relevant chunks retrieved in the first K.
components.tradeoffs: Measures coverage; requires sufficiently complete relevance labels.

components.name: MRR
components.description: Reciprocal rank of the first relevant result.
components.tradeoffs: Good for first-answer position; ignores later relevant results.

components.name: nDCG@K
components.description: Position-discounted ranking quality normalized to the ideal ordering.
components.tradeoffs: Sensitive to ranking order; harder to explain and label.
